title: NormalizedPaymentRequired
description:
tx402's internal normalized form of an x402 v2 PaymentRequired challenge (SPEC §5.1).

This is NOT the wire format. The wire format is upstream's `PaymentRequired` — `{x402Version, error?, resource, accepts[], extensions?}` — decoded by `@x402/core/http`. tx402 maps it once, at the decoder boundary (ADR-010 decision 1):

  upstream `accepts[]`  -> `requirements[]`
  upstream `amount`     -> `amountAtomic`
  upstream `x402Version`-> `protocolVersion`

`resource.method` has no upstream counterpart. tx402 issued the request, so it populates the method from its own request rather than parsing it (ADR-010 decision 2).

protocolVersion.description: Exactly 2. Any other observed version raises UnsupportedProtocolError and is never heuristically parsed (ADR-004).

url.description: The challenge's declared resource URL. Its normalized origin MUST match the origin tx402 actually requested; a mismatch is InvalidPaymentRequiredError (ADR-010 decision 2).

method.description: Populated by tx402 from the request it issued, uppercased. Not challenge-derived.

requirements.description: 1–32 entries. Input ordering from `accepts[]` is preserved exactly; `index` records it so that route ordering can fall back to it deterministically (SPEC §6.4 step 18).

receivedAt.description: When tx402 received the challenge, by its injected clock. Not merchant-supplied — upstream v2 carries no timestamp (ADR-010 decision 3).

headerHash.description: SHA-256 of the raw PAYMENT-REQUIRED header bytes. Diagnostics and idempotency only — never authorization material.

error.description: Upstream's optional human-readable `error` string, carried through untouched. Merchant-controlled text: it is never interpreted, and it is redacted from logs by default (SEC-003).

index.description: Zero-based position in the upstream `accepts[]` array, preserved through normalization.

network.description: Canonical CAIP-2, already alias-resolved. MUST be present in the signed release manifest.

asset.description: Contract address (EVM) or mint (SVM), exactly as offered. Validated by the network handler, not here.

amountAtomic.description: Upstream `amount`, renamed. Unsigned base-10 integer string, strictly greater than zero (SPEC §5.1).

maxTimeoutSeconds.description: Merchant's authorization lifetime bound. tx402's authorization lifetime is min(60s, this) and MUST never exceed it (SPEC §6.6).

extra.description: Scheme-specific opaque data, passed to the upstream scheme handler unmodified. Also the only place a challenge timestamp can appear, which is why `routing.maxQuoteAgeMs` is inert for standard v2 challenges (ADR-010 decision 3).

rawHash.description: SHA-256 of this requirement's canonical upstream form. Diagnostics and idempotency only.
